dogecoin.text:
What started as a goofy joke became the loudest buzz in the crypto market. Click on the link to read more about Dogecoin’s absurd journey.

(T&C & Disclaimers applicable)
https://t.co/I1M4khFP3R
Elon Musk’s SpaceX announced the launch of satellite DOGE-1 next year which will be completely funded by the meme cryptocurrency, Dogecoin. Crazy? Oh yes!

2013: Dogecoin launches as a joke to pay a satirical homage to Bitcoin. 
2021: Dogecoin surges ~20,000% up in the last year, has a ~$65 Billion market cap and is going to – yes – the moon! 🚀
